name: cyberark
label: CyberArk
description: Manage users, groups, and access controls in CyberArk Privileged Access Management

create_user.label: Create User
create_user.description: Creates a new user in the CyberArk Vault

username.label: Username
username.description: The name of the user (max 128 characters)

userType.label: User Type
userType.description: The user type according to license

allowedAuthenticationMethods.label: Allowed Authentication Methods
allowedAuthenticationMethods.description: Non-Vault authentication methods the user can use. A JSON list of SAML and PKI, such as ["SAML"].

location.label: Location
location.description: Vault location for user creation (must start with \\)

enableUser.label: Enable User
enableUser.description: Whether the user will be enabled upon creation

changePassOnNextLogon.label: Change Password on Next Logon
changePassOnNextLogon.description: User must change password on next login

passwordNeverExpires.label: Password Never Expires
passwordNeverExpires.description: Password will not expire unless user changes it

vaultAuthorization.label: Vault Authorization
vaultAuthorization.description: User permissions. A JSON list of: AddSafes, AuditUsers, AddUpdateUsers, ResetUsersPasswords, ActivateUsers, AddNetworkAreas, ManageDirectoryMapping, ManageServerFileCategories, BackupAllSafes, RestoreAllSafes.

expiryDate.label: Expiry Date
expiryDate.description: Date when the user expires, as a date and time such as 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z

unAuthorizedInterfaces.label: Unauthorized Interfaces
unAuthorizedInterfaces.description: Interfaces the user cannot access. A JSON list of: PSM, PSMP, PVWA, WINCLIENT, PTA, PACLI, HTTPGW, EVD, PIMSu, AIMApp, CPM, PVWAApp, PSMApp, AppPrv, PSMPApp.

update_user.label: Update User
update_user.description: Updates an existing Vault user (except Master and Batch built-in users)

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: The ID of the Vault user to update.

username.label: Username
username.description: The name of the user (max 128 characters)

userType.label: User Type
userType.description: The user type according to license

changePassOnNextLogon.label: Change Password on Next Logon
changePassOnNextLogon.description: User must change password on next login

passwordNeverExpires.label: Password Never Expires
passwordNeverExpires.description: Password will not expire unless user changes it

expiryDate.label: Expiry Date
expiryDate.description: Date when the user expires, as a date and time such as 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z

userActivityLogRetentionDays.label: Activity Log Retention Days
userActivityLogRetentionDays.description: Days to retain user activity records (default: 90)

allowedAuthenticationMethods.label: Allowed Authentication Methods
allowedAuthenticationMethods.description: Non-Vault authentication methods the user can use. A JSON list of SAML and PKI, such as ["SAML"].

unAuthorizedInterfaces.label: Unauthorized Interfaces
unAuthorizedInterfaces.description: CyberArk interfaces this user cannot access. A JSON list of: PIMSU, PSM, PSMP, PVWA, WINCLIENT, PTA, PACLI, HTTPGW, EVD, PIMSu, AIMApp, CPM, PVWAApp, PSMApp, AppPrv, PSMPApp.

password.label: Password
password.description: New password for the user (max 39 characters)

vaultAuthorization.label: Vault Authorization
vaultAuthorization.description: User permissions. A JSON list of: AddSafes, AuditUsers, AddUpdateUsers, ResetUsersPasswords, ActivateUsers, AddNetworkAreas, ManageDirectoryMapping, ManageServerFileCategories, BackupAllSafes, RestoreAllSafes.

loginFromHour.label: Login From Hour
loginFromHour.description: Starting time when user can log in, as a date and time such as 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z

loginToHour.label: Login To Hour
loginToHour.description: Ending time when user can log in, as a date and time such as 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z

delete_user.label: Delete User
delete_user.description: Deletes a specific user in the Vault (requires Add/Update Users authorization)

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: The ID of the Vault user to delete.

confirmDeletion.label: Confirm Deletion
confirmDeletion.description: Check this box to confirm you want to delete the selected user. This action cannot be undone.

delete_user.beforeRequest:
if (String(inputs.confirmDeletion) !== 'true') throw new Error('Please check the confirmation box to proceed with user deletion.');
return request;
delete_user.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: `User ${inputs.userId} deleted successfully` };

activate_user.label: Activate User
activate_user.description: Activates an existing user who was suspended after entering incorrect credentials multiple times

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: The ID of the suspended Vault user.

activate_user.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: `User ${inputs.userId} activated successfully` };

enable_user.label: Enable User
enable_user.description: Enables a specific user in the Vault

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: The ID of the Vault user to enable.

enable_user.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: `User ${inputs.userId} enabled successfully` };

disable_user.label: Disable User
disable_user.description: Disables a specific user in the Vault

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: The ID of the Vault user to disable.

disable_user.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: `User ${inputs.userId} disabled successfully` };

find_user.label: Find User
find_user.description: Returns a list of existing users in the Vault based on filter criteria (requires Audit users permissions)

filter.label: Filter
filter.description: Filter users by userType, componentUser, or userName

search.label: Search
search.description: Search by username, firstname, or lastname

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort by property (username, source, userType, location, lastname, firstname, middlename) followed by asc/desc

extendedDetails.label: Extended Details
extendedDetails.description: Returns additional user details including groups and userDN for LDAP users

pageOffset.label: Page Offset
pageOffset.description: Offset the first user returned in results

pageSize.label: Page Size
pageSize.description: Maximum number of users to return (used with offset)

componentUser.label: Component User Only
componentUser.description: Filter to show only component users

add_member_to_group.label: Add Member to Group
add_member_to_group.description: Adds a user as a member to an existing Vault group (requires Add/Update users permissions)

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: The ID of the Vault user group.

memberId.label: Member
memberId.description: The Vault user name or LDAP group name to add to the group.

memberType.label: Member Type
memberType.description: The type of user being added to the Vault group

domainName.label: Domain Name
domainName.description: The DNS address of the domain (required if memberType is domain)

add_member_to_group.beforeRequest:
if (inputs.memberType === 'domain' && !inputs.domainName) throw new Error('Domain name is required when member type is "domain"');
return request;
add_member_to_group.afterResponse: return { success: true, member: response, message: `Successfully added ${inputs.memberId} to group ${inputs.groupId}` };

remove_member_from_group.label: Remove Member from Group
remove_member_from_group.description: Removes a specific user from a user group in the Vault

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: The ID of the Vault user group.

memberId.label: Member
memberId.description: The Vault user name or LDAP group name to remove from the group.

remove_member_from_group.afterResponse: return { success: true, message: `Successfully removed ${inputs.memberId} from group ${inputs.groupId}` };

get_password_value.label: Get Password Value
get_password_value.description: Retrieves the password or SSH key of an existing account identified by its Account ID

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The ID of the Vault account.

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: The reason for retrieving the password/SSH key

ticketingSystemName.label: Ticketing System Name
ticketingSystemName.description: The name of the Ticketing System

ticketId.label: Ticket ID
ticketId.description: The ticket ID of the ticketing system

version.label: Version
version.description: The version number of the required password. If there are no previous versions, the current password/key version is returned.

actionType.label: Action Type
actionType.description: The action this password will be used for

isUse.label: Is Use
isUse.description: Internal parameter (for PSM for SSH only)

machine.label: Machine
machine.description: The address of the remote machine to connect to

retrieve_private_ssh_key.label: Retrieve Private SSH Key
retrieve_private_ssh_key.description: Retrieves a private SSH key file from an existing account identified by its Account ID

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The ID of the Vault account.

reason.label: Reason
reason.description: The reason for retrieving the private SSH key

ticketingSystemName.label: Ticketing System Name
ticketingSystemName.description: The name of the ticketing system

ticketId.label: Ticket ID
ticketId.description: The ticket ID defined in the ticketing system

version.label: Version
version.description: The version number of the required SSH key. Must be a positive number. If left empty or the value does not exist, the current SSH key version is returned.

actionType.label: Action Type
actionType.description: The action this SSH key is used for

isUse.label: Is Use
isUse.description: Internal parameter (for use of PSMP only)

machine.label: Machine
machine.description: The address of the remote machine to connect to using the SSH key

change_credentials_in_vault.label: Change Credentials in the Vault
change_credentials_in_vault.description: Sets account credentials and changes them in the Vault. This will not affect credentials on the target device.

accountId.label: Account ID
accountId.description: The ID of the Vault account.

newCredentials.label: New Credentials
newCredentials.description: The new account credentials that will be allocated to the account in the Vault. Leading and trailing white spaces will be automatically removed.

change_credentials_in_vault.afterResponse: return { success: true, details: response ?? undefined };

verify_credentials_bulk.label: Verify Credentials in Bulk
verify_credentials_bulk.description: Marks multiple accounts for verification by the CPM

accountIds.label: Account IDs
accountIds.description: List of unique account IDs to verify. A JSON list, such as ["12_3", "12_4"].

verify_credentials_bulk.afterResponse: return { success: true, details: response ?? undefined };

change_credentials_bulk.label: Change Credentials Immediately in Bulk
change_credentials_bulk.description: Marks multiple accounts for an immediate credentials change by the CPM to a new random value

accountIds.label: Account IDs
accountIds.description: List of unique account IDs to change credentials for. A JSON list, such as ["12_3", "12_4"].

changeEntireGroup.label: Change Entire Group
changeEntireGroup.description: Whether the CPM changes the credentials for all accounts in the same account group. Only applies to accounts that belong to an account group.

change_credentials_bulk.beforeRequest:
request.body = { bulkItems: JSON.parse(inputs.accountIds).map((accountId) => ({ accountId, ChangeEntireGroup: inputs.changeEntireGroup === 'true' })) };
return request;
change_credentials_bulk.afterResponse: return { success: true, details: response ?? undefined };

set_next_password_bulk.label: Set Next Password in Bulk
set_next_password_bulk.description: Sets multiple accounts' credentials to use for the next CPM change

bulkItems.label: Bulk Items
bulkItems.description: List of account items. Each item should be a JSON object with accountId (required), changeImmediately (optional), and newCredentials (optional). A JSON list, such as [{"accountId": "12_3", "changeImmediately": true}].

set_next_password_bulk.beforeRequest:
request.body = { bulkItems: JSON.parse(inputs.bulkItems).map((item) => typeof item === 'string' ? JSON.parse(item) : item) };
return request;
set_next_password_bulk.afterResponse: return { success: true, details: response ?? undefined };

change_credentials_in_vault_bulk.label: Change Credentials in the Vault in Bulk
change_credentials_in_vault_bulk.description: Sets credentials for multiple accounts and changes them in the Vault. This does not affect credentials on the target device.

bulkItems.label: Bulk Items
bulkItems.description: List of account items. Each item should be a JSON object with accountId (required) and newCredentials (optional). A JSON list, such as [{"accountId": "12_3", "newCredentials": "..."}].

change_credentials_in_vault_bulk.beforeRequest:
request.body = { bulkItems: JSON.parse(inputs.bulkItems).map((item) => typeof item === 'string' ? JSON.parse(item) : item) };
return request;
change_credentials_in_vault_bulk.afterResponse: return { success: true, details: response ?? undefined };

reconcile_credentials_bulk.label: Reconcile Credentials in Bulk
reconcile_credentials_bulk.description: Marks multiple accounts for automatic reconciliation by the CPM

accountIds.label: Account IDs
accountIds.description: List of unique account IDs to reconcile. A JSON list, such as ["12_3", "12_4"].

reconcile_credentials_bulk.afterResponse: return { success: true, details: response ?? undefined };
